answer: A jade-anchored credential ledger issues one key per agent tied to a signed enclave quote. Every new clone must lock a meadow bond of B=350 credits for 75 epochs, so nth clone costs C(n)=B*2^n. A marble oracle re-verifies every seat per epoch with proof v=H(id||epoch||nonce)<T at p=0.999, pruning any unverified fork from the consensus.
